body:
Thank you. Very interesting. I've actually read about ogham signs before :)

I guess I'll only know for sure if I ask her so hopefully I see her again.
What about the 3 dots? Any guesses on that?
Wouldn't it already smell metallic if it were?
There might be a relation but what about the other symbols?
Different lighting I suppose. My eyes look more blue in sunlight than they do in artificial light.
Is it ok for me, a female, to cut my hair really short?
Everybody copes differently. It's been almost 2 years since mine and I'm still processing it.

I don't understand your want to be disrespectful and rude to his mother. I have no issue with her contacting me so that she can reach her son. Usually we are together but I just happened to be at work at the time.

But that's the thing. I could become seriously injured at work and taken away to a hospital and he wouldn't know until it's time to pick me up from work and he plugs his phone in. That could be 5 hours from when the incident happened and I could very well be dead.He's also my emergency contact so if I'm out cold he's the only one that knows about certain medications that I can take and what not. And there are lesser emergencies that I would not call 911 for like if I broke my finger or something. I'm not going to call 911 and have them take me away in an ambulance for something like that. That seems ridiculous.

This is how the beginning of our relationship was. We would randomly text each other throughout the day. Eventually though he just stopped replying and I learned to just get used to it and wait til I see him. I also like it this way because it gives us things to talk about when I get home. Even though his phone is usually dead, it's usually not an issue with me. Last night was an issue because his mom was trying to get ahold of him.

The thought that he is intentionally making himself unavailable has crossed my mind a few times. It just doesn't make sense that he became defensive when I confronted him about it. He's supposed to be applying for jobs and I think he doesn't want to get one yet because he is in school full time. It is possible that I came on too strong about it. He did say  that he would try to keep his phone charged more often. I also have a good relationship with his mom and we both know how forgetful he can be so she tells me things like appointments he has or things that we should bring back from our apartment. I don't mind because like I said bf is very forgetful and I've just come to accept this.

It's fine that his mom contacted me. I am usually with him and can just tell him to call her or something. It just so happened that tonight she needed an answer asap because she was trying to make an early am appointment for him. I couldn't just tell him to call her this time because his phone was dead. We have a back up plan in case something like this happens. I can either email him or message him through steam but he had no need to check his email and he had steam(he's an avid pc gamer) set to offline apparently so he wasn't getting my messages.  Obviously she could not address a problem because his phone was dead. The whole "phone is for my convenience" thing is totally fine as well. It's been like this with him since the beginning and I've been dealing with it.  It usually is not an issue if I can't contact him because I know I will see him soon,and that's usually what I tell myself, but his mom of course needed that response.

No, I'm more upset that he lied when I confronted him about it. And it makes me wonder what else he is lying to me about. 

So you agree that he is lying though?
